children.title: CodexBar
children.description: A free, open-source macOS menu-bar app that shows limits and reset timers at a glance across dozens of AI providers, plus credit balances and spending.

children.title: ccusage
children.description: An open-source CLI that reads local agent logs to report token usage and cost across 15 coding-agent sources, with caching-aware pricing.

children.title: CodeBurn
children.description: An open-source tracker for 36 coding tools whose optimize command flags named harness-waste patterns with dollar estimates it later checks against actuals.

children.title: Claude Code Usage Monitor
children.description: A live terminal dashboard for Claude Code usage, with burn-rate analytics, P90 limit detection, and session-expiry forecasts.

children.title: gh-aw (GitHub Agentic Workflows)
children.description: GitHub's agentic-workflows runtime with first-party per-run token and cost metering, plus budget caps that stop a workflow mid-run.

children.title: OpenUsage
children.description: A native Swift macOS menu-bar meter for 10 AI coding subscriptions, showing session and weekly limits, credits, and estimated spend from local credentials.

children.title: OpenLIT
children.description: An open-source (Apache-2.0), OpenTelemetry-native platform with a self-hosted dashboard for LLM cost, token, and latency observability.

children.title: claude-usage
children.description: A local dashboard for Claude Code token usage, costs, and session history; Pro and Max subscribers get a quota progress bar.

children.title: ClaudeBar
children.description: A macOS menu-bar app that monitors AI coding quotas across 11 providers; the README declares MIT but ships no license file, so the OSS grant is unconfirmed.

children.title: TokenTracker
children.description: A local-first token and cost dashboard for 27 coding tools, with a desktop pet, native widgets, and achievements as a distinct gamified take on usage metering.

children.title: CodeZeno Usage Monitor
children.description: A Windows taskbar widget showing real-time Claude Code quota and usage at a glance, without opening a terminal.

children.title: Codex Usage Tracker
children.description: A local-first dashboard, CLI, and MCP tools indexing Codex CLI logs into SQLite to show where tokens, credits, and cost go, including cache ratios.

children.title: OpenLLMetry
children.description: An open-source set of OpenTelemetry-based SDKs and instrumentations, built by Traceloop, for LLM apps.

children.title: OpenTelemetry GenAI Semantic Conventions
children.description: OpenTelemetry's GenAI Semantic Conventions define the vendor-neutral token, cost, and cache attribute names that OpenLLMetry and Phoenix both converge on.

children.title: Opik
children.description: Comet's open-source (Apache-2.0) LLM observability platform, with per-span USD cost estimated from token usage.

children.title: Arize Phoenix
children.description: A source-available (Elastic License 2.0) LLM tracing platform recording per-span token counts and USD cost via OpenTelemetry.

children.title: claude-tap
children.description: A local trace viewer intercepting API traffic from 14+ coding agents, showing per-request token breakdowns: input, output, cache read, cache creation.

children.title: LMCache
children.description: A self-hosted KV-cache layer beneath vLLM, giving token-level cache-hit observability for teams who own their GPUs, not a hosted bill.

children.title: prompt-cache
children.description: A Go LLM proxy that adds a three-tier semantic cache: high similarity hits directly, low skips, and a gray zone runs a cheap verification model.

children.title: khazad
children.description: A transport-layer semantic cache for LLM APIs on Redis 8 Vector Sets: it intercepts HTTP traffic with zero application code changes and replays cached responses.

children.title: Ollama
children.description: A runtime for running open-weight models like Qwen, DeepSeek, and GLM-5.1 locally, shifting inference onto hardware you already own.

children.title: llama.cpp
children.description: The foundational open-source (MIT) local LLM inference engine most of the local ecosystem runs on, with an OpenAI-compatible server built in.

children.title: rtk
children.description: A single-binary Rust CLI proxy that intercepts and compresses the output of common dev commands before it reaches an LLM coding agent's context window. Its headline figures are token reduction, not measured cost reduction.

children.title: headroom
children.description: An Apache-2.0 context-compression tool for LLM/agent pipelines at 65,698 GitHub stars (2026-08-10), confirmed organic by star-forensics.

children.title: TOON (Token-Oriented Object Notation)
children.description: TOON is a compact, human-readable, lossless serialization of the JSON data model, designed for LLM input.

children.title: Context Mode
children.description: This MCP server sandboxes tool calls and returns only the distilled result, claiming a 98% cut: 315 KB of output down to 5.4 KB.

children.title: LLMLingua
children.description: Microsoft's prompt-compression library that uses a small model to drop low-information tokens before a prompt reaches the target LLM.

children.title: lean-ctx - MCP context layer with a self-measured savings ledger
children.description: Rust MCP server that mediates what a coding agent reads, with a self-measured 60-90% token-reduction headline, a reported quality column, and an accounting of its own context overhead.

children.title: llmtrim
children.description: A local proxy that compresses a coding agent's prompt, tool schemas, and history before forwarding and can reroute Claude calls to Grok.

children.title: Codex CLI compaction cost - over-eager compaction as a token-amplification loop
children.description: Upgrading Codex CLI from v0.116 to v0.118 made context compaction fire twice as often, doubling or tripling token consumption for identical tasks.

children.title: Serena
children.description: An open-source (MIT) MCP toolkit that gives a coding agent IDE-grade semantic code retrieval and editing: 'the IDE for your coding agent'.

children.title: Repomix
children.description: Packs an entire repository into a single AI-friendly file, reporting token counts and using Tree-sitter to compress code to signatures only.

children.title: RULER
children.description: NVIDIA's RULER benchmark found that of models claiming 32K+ token context windows, only half actually maintain quality once you fill them to 32K.

children.title: LiteLLM
children.description: An open-source gateway fronting 100+ LLM APIs that computes real per-request dollar cost from a live pricing map, with spend limits.

children.title: Bifrost (Maxim AI)
children.description: Bifrost is a Go-based AI gateway fronting 1,000+ models that measured just 11 microseconds of added latency per request at 5,000 requests per second.

children.title: claude-mem
children.description: A coding-agent observational-memory layer that captures every session, compresses it with AI, and re-injects relevant context next time.

children.title: Mem0
children.description: An open-source memory layer that extracts salient facts from conversations and retrieves only the relevant ones per call, not the full history.

children.title: Zep / Graphiti
children.description: A memory platform for agents built on temporal knowledge graphs; it self-reports serving benchmark answers from a few thousand tokens of retrieved context. (also: Graphiti (OSS engine) · zep repo)

children.title: Cognee
children.description: An open-source (Apache-2.0) AI-memory platform giving agents persistent memory via a self-hosted knowledge graph, via remember/recall/forget.

children.title: Supermemory
children.description: A memory and context engine that self-reports 95% recall on LongMemEval while adding only ~720 tokens of context.

children.title: Letta (MemGPT)
children.description: The MemGPT lineage project: a platform for stateful agents that pages an LLM's context like an OS.

children.title: LangMem
children.description: LangChain's long-term memory library: it extracts and consolidates facts from conversations and integrates natively with LangGraph's memory store.

children.title: claude-code-memory-setup
children.description: A practitioner recipe pairing an Obsidian memory vault with a local AST code-graph tool.

children.title: benjamin-plus - JetBrains' own token-efficiency skill, measured on its own published A/B rig
children.description: A 745-token instruction payload from JetBrains that changes how a coding agent looks things up and waits; the repo reports −17.9% median cost on 80 paired SkillsBench tasks with quality tied, and publishes no raw data.

children.title: token-ninja
children.description: Intercepts deterministic commands like or before they reach the model, running them locally and skipping the LLM call.

children.title: PageIndex
children.description: Vectorless RAG engine that builds a hierarchical tree index over long documents and has an LLM reason over the index instead of embedding chunks.

children.title: Signet AI
children.description: Local-first memory and context layer that syncs memories, transcripts and secrets across Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and other harnesses.

children.title: ruflo (formerly Claude-Flow) - cost-adjusted model routing
children.description: ruflo is an open-source agent meta-harness for Claude Code and Codex, providing swarm orchestration and persistent memory. Ships on npm as (v3.17.0).

children.title: Claude Code Router
children.description: A local gateway that puts Claude Code, Codex, and other coding CLIs behind one endpoint and routes each request by ordered condition rules, Node.js script rules, or a prompt tag that lets the agent pick a model per subagent. The project publishes no savings figure, and routing scripts run as fully trusted code next to your credentials - only use scripts you wrote yourself.

children.title: Plano (formerly archgw)
children.description: An Envoy-based proxy whose router matches queries to user-defined domains and actions via a small routing model, rather than picking by benchmark rank. Since July 2026 it also prices the warm cache a model switch would discard, and vetoes switches once their cumulative cost passes a configured overhead cap.

children.title: vLLM Semantic Router
children.description: Sends routine queries to cheap or local models and hard ones to stronger backends, as an open-source, self-hostable router.

children.title: Antigravity CLI - per-subagent model-tier routing + /effort (v1.1.5)
children.description: Antigravity CLI v1.1.5 shipped first-party per-subagent model-tier routing (a model: flash|pro field in custom-agent frontmatter) plus an /effort control.

children.title: Weave Router
children.description: A drop-in proxy that picks a model for every request with an on-box embedding cluster scorer derived from Avengers-Pro, speaking all three provider APIs (BYOK, OTLP traces, one-command setup for Claude Code, Codex, and opencode). Source-available under Elastic License 2.0, which bars offering it as a hosted service; its cost-reduction figures are vendor-reported, not independently measured.

children.title: NadirClaw - a pre-router proxy, with its benchmark attached to the paid tier
children.description: An OpenAI-compatible pre-router proxy for coding harnesses: a ~10ms embedding classifier picks the cheapest model predicted to answer, verifies the answer against quality heuristics, and escalates on failure. Its committed RouterBench numbers belong to the paid Nadir Pro classifier, not the free OSS one.

children.title: opencode-fusion
children.description: An OpenCode config layer that denies the main agent's edit and search tools so they are removed from its tool schema entirely, forcing every file change through a cheaper sidekick agent. Model assignments are fixed per role at startup, and the project publishes no savings measurement of its own.

children.title: Harness-native heuristic pre-routers - two mechanism-only per-turn routers
children.description: Two mechanism-only heuristic per-turn routers - one for the pi coding agent, one an OpenCode plugin - route each turn to a model tier by keyword and word-count heuristics. Neither ships a measured savings number, and the OpenCode entry's headline percentage is an assumed-inputs arithmetic simulation, not telemetry. (also: opencode-model-router)

children.title: Firecrawl
children.description: A web scraping API that converts pages to markdown or structured JSON before they reach the model, billed at 1 credit per page.

children.title: Valyu
children.description: A search and deep-research API whose cost-versus-accuracy results on the third-party DRACO benchmark ship with an open harness, raw outputs and per-provider runners; the harness repo carries no license file.

children.title: vLLM
children.description: The canonical open-source LLM serving engine, using PagedAttention to manage KV-cache memory in blocks so more requests batch at lower cost.

children.title: SGLang
children.description: A high-performance serving framework for large language and multimodal models.

children.title: CodeCarbon
children.description: An open-source (MIT) library for estimating a workload's energy use and CO2e emissions, and ML's widely-cited carbon baseline.

children.title: EcoLogits
children.description: Estimates the energy and carbon footprint of calling generative-AI APIs: the hosted counterpart to CodeCarbon, which measures your own hardware.

children.title: AEGIS
children.description: An open-source (MIT) pre-execution firewall and cryptographic audit layer for AI agents.

children.title: ActPlane
children.description: An eBPF-based, OS-level policy-enforcement engine for AI-agent harnesses like Claude Code and Codex.

children.title: MCPGuard-Dynamic
children.description: An early-stage, research-grade kernel-level eBPF sandbox for MCP (64★), published under Meta's official GitHub org.

children.title: OpenHands - MIT OSS coding agent, free local + free cloud tier, at-cost LLM option
children.description: An MIT-licensed open-source coding-agent platform with a free local mode, a free cloud tier, and an at-cost LLM pricing option.

children.title: Cline - an OSS coding agent on a bring-your-own-key cost model
children.description: An open-source AI coding agent (Apache-2.0, ~65k★, ~4.8M VS Code installs), built on a bring-your-own-API-key cost model.

children.title: Aider - an OSS coding CLI that meters its own dollar cost
children.description: An open-source terminal coding agent (Apache-2.0, ~48k★) with built-in per-message dollar-cost tracking and a public polyglot leaderboard.

children.title: promptfoo
children.description: An open-source CLI/CI harness for testing LLM prompts and agents that records per-eval token usage and cost as an assertable metric.

children.title: SWE-bench
children.description: The canonical accuracy-only software-engineering benchmark (2,294 real GitHub issue tasks, 12 Python repos, ICLR 2024). The cost-aware derivatives in this list build on it.

children.title: LongMemEval
children.description: The peer-reviewed (ICLR 2025) benchmark for long-term memory in chat assistants.

children.title: MemoryBench
children.description: A pluggable harness to run memory systems (Supermemory, Mem0, Zep) head-to-head across datasets like LoCoMo; useful for standardizing comparison.

children.title: RouterArena
children.description: An open evaluation platform and live leaderboard for LLM routers - systems that auto-select a model per query.

children.title: Claw-SWE-Bench
children.description: Found that adapter/harness design alone swings an agent's Pass@1 score by about 54 percentage points on the identical model backbone.

children.title: Multi-vendor system-prompt and tool-schema corpus (x1xhlol)
children.description: A 35-vendor collection of extracted agent system prompts with separate tool-schema JSON files (Claude Code's Tools.json alone is 48,962 bytes), published as raw text with no token counts.

children.title: Multi-vendor system-prompt corpus (asgeirtj)
children.description: A 481-file prompt corpus under CC0 covering harnesses others miss (Antigravity CLI at 24,493 bytes and Copilot CLI at 72,738), with dated Anthropic prompt series but no token counts.

children.title: Claude Code system prompts (Piebald extraction)
children.description: Piebald AI extracts Claude Code's full compiled prompt payload per release: 515 prompt strings and 27 tool descriptions at v2.1.212, each priced in tokens.

children.title: OpenCost - AI inference cost tracking
children.description: The CNCF Kubernetes cost tool's 2026-07 feature turns GPU and shared-infrastructure spend on vLLM/llm-d deployments into cost per million tokens, reconciled to the infrastructure bill.

children.title: Cross-vendor coding-agent usage trackers (AgentsView · caut)
children.description: AgentsView and caut are open-source tools that read local session logs to aggregate token usage and cost across roughly 20 coding-agent vendors.

children.title: tokview
children.description: A local, zero-config proxy showing a coding agent's token spend by session, model, and tool call, flagging re-sent results that multiply the bill.
